name: Text
summary: Apply an existing Mux typography role to semantic text while preserving native and slot behavior.

useWhen: Applying Mux display, heading, title, label, body, expressive, or mono typography to text content.
Building a page hierarchy of title, section headings, body text, and labels, with the heading level chosen apart from the look.
avoidWhen: Creating a layout wrapper or a new typography treatment.
Making something that can be pressed; use Button or Link.
Naming a field that has its own label or label prop; use that.

obligations: The as prop selects the native semantic host; caller-supplied role, aria, data, event, and slot props remain on that host.

Text can fill a field's description slot and a collection item's label and description slots; a field's label association remains owned by the field component, while as=label with htmlFor provides native labeling. Without a slot prop, Text fills a collection item's default label slot and stays out of field label and description contexts, which have only named slots.
Truncation is visual; the complete text remains in the DOM and consumers provide an accessible name when a clipped label needs additional context.

behavior: variant selects the typography role: display, heading, title, label, body, expressive, or mono.
display, heading, and title support the sizes sm, md, and lg; label, body, expressive, and mono also support xs.
The as prop selects p, span, h1 through h6, div, or label without changing caller-supplied role, aria, data, event, or slot props.
The color prop keeps default role color, or applies the existing muted content role.
truncate clips the text to a single line and ends it with an ellipsis.
A truncated block host stays a block; a truncated inline host becomes an inline block aligned to the bottom.
Text sets no width of its own, so it clips only where its container limits the width.
variant="label" selects label typography only; it does not associate the text with a field.
as="label" renders a native label, and its htmlFor targets a native input by id.
Inside a field, Text with slot="description" becomes the field's description.
Inside a collection item, Text with slot="label" or slot="description" fills that slot, and Text without a slot fills the label.
accessibility: The selected native element supplies its normal semantic meaning and caller-supplied role and ARIA attributes are preserved.
Text can fill a field's description slot and a collection item's label and description slots; field labels retain the field component's association, and as=label with htmlFor remains native labeling.
Truncation does not remove the complete text from the DOM.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
